description_en: Lũchẽ Nani Phalcā frames the historic Cābahāl (Jyābahāḥbah) to the left, with Cābahāl  Phalcā (LAL4101) to the right. Bothphalcāsare used for the regular performance of devotional songs (dapha bhajana). The five-bay, two-storey high Lũchẽ Nani Phalcā is situated at the southern edge of the street between Oku Bāhāla and Tangaḥ. An artistic gate made of bricks with a tiled roof is attached to thephalcāand marks the entry to the residential compound that surrounds the old monastic building. Thephalcāused to be closed with latticed windows before it was reconstructed after 2015. After the reconstruction, all bays have been opened again. The height of the upper floor was increased in 2016-17. The bhajana instruments are kept there.Until about 1950 CE, thephalcāwas one storey high. In 1977 CE, theBālakumārīLibrary was opened on the ground floor. At that time, an additonal floor was made to allow for instruments to be stored and music to be played, and neighbours remember that they played on straw mats on the first floor.Thephalcāand the whole site being relevant to the passing of the Bungadhyo Procecession, many people gather at Lũchẽ Nani Phalcā to celebrate at that time of the year.
description_ne: यो पाँच कवल भएको दुई तले लुँछेँ ननि फल्चा ओकु बाहालबाट तङ्गःतर्फ जाने सडकखण्डको दक्षिण किनारातर्फ रहेको छ । झिँगटीले छाएको एउटा कलात्मक ढोका (ईंटाद्वारा निर्मित) यो फल्चासँगै जोडिएको छ । यस ढोकाबाट एउटा पुरानो बाहालको प्राङ्गणभित्र प्रवेश गर्न सकिन्छ । २०७२ सालको भूकम्पपछि फल्चाको पछाडिपट्टिको पर्खाल र त्यसभन्दा पछिको एउटा व्यक्तिगत घर पूर्ण रूपमा भत्केको हुनाले अहिले त्यो घर फल्चासँग जोडिएको छैन । फल्चा चारैतर्फ खुला थियो । पश्चिमतर्फका पाँच र दक्षिणतर्फका दुई कवलहरू आँखीझ्याल हालेर बन्द गरिएका छन् । दक्षिणतर्फ फर्केका दुई कवलहरूमध्ये एउटा कवललाई फल्चाको प्रवेशद्वारको रूपमा परिणत गरिएको छ । फल्चाको माथिल्लो तलाको उचाई बढाएको छ र तीनै दिशाहरूतर्फ ठुला आँखीझ्यालहरू थपिएका छन् । चारै दिशामा खुला रहेको फल्चा बन्द गर्नुको निम्न कारणहरू दिइएका छन्: शिशिर याममा भजन गायन गर्दा धेरै जाडो हुने भएकोले, नचाहिने मानिसहरूको प्रवेश निषेध हुने भएकोले र गैरकानूनी रूपमा फल्चाको जग्गा मिचिनबाट रोकिने भएकोले ।
monument_assessment: Rebuilt, Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired)
references: Sources and references Sources Inscription of NS 788 (1668 CE) On Tuesday, [1] 6th day of the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha NS 833, Statue of Amoghapāśa Lokeśvara has been erected in the Phalcā. On Wednesday, 8th day of the bright fortnight of Bhādra NS 832, Ranhasiṃha Bhāvo, Parusiṃha Bhāvo, Lvayarāma Bhāvo, his son Ratnaki Rāma Bhāvo, Lakṣmīrāma Bhāvo, Dhanaṃsiṃha Bhāvo, Viśvarāma Bhāvo all from Jyābāhā Bahī ṭola made a Phalcā and established a guṭhī donating 1 karṣa (1/4 ropanī ) land for its management. With the income of the land every year on the 14th day of the bright fortnight of Bhādra, 1 pāthī beaten rice with 2 prastha meat, 1 kuḍa soaked pea and 1 prastha soybean should be distributed sitting in the Phalcā. [1] The date is unclear Details Dedicated to Rokyaśvara and Śaktī, Harirāma Bhāvo and his wife Dhavaṃti of the Lũchẽ Nani sponsored the construction of the phalcā to the east of Jyāthabāhāra Vihāra, completed on Saturday, the third day of the bright lunar fortnight of Vaiśākha in NS 788 (1668 CE). नेसं ७८८ वैशाख शुक्ल तृतिया, सञ्चरबार खुनु हरिराम भावो व वय्‌क:या तिरि धवंन्तिं ज्याथबाहार विहारया पूर्वय् थुगु फल्चा दय्‌का: शक्ति सहितया लोकेश्वर छम्ह नं पलिस्था या:गु जुल ।

historical_events.event_name: Consecration of the Amoghapāśa Lokeśvara statue
historical_events.event_description: Expansion of bays with the help of a collective donation in 1712 CE. Consecration of statue of Amoghapāśa Lokeśvara, 1713 CE.

Lũchẽ Nani Phalcā was reconstructed after being damaged in the 2015 earthquakes, with the support of the Barbara and Wilfried Mohr Fundation, Hamburg. The inauguration took place in March 2017. The South Asia Institute's HelpNepal initiative accompanied the process.
